name: COMPONENT_LINK
description: A line of a unit's component diagram (#617): from the subject component to another component of the unit, or, for a link between containers whose code end is in the component, to the link's other end. It rests on the calls, routes, advice or links it gathers.

kind.description: A route applying a filter of the other component; a call into its code; an aspect advising its entry point; or the code end of a link between containers.

relationship.description: The line's relationship: CALLS or ADVISES between components, else the link's predicate, such as CALLS_HTTP.

at.description: The entity ID of the code it rests on: the calling method, the route's member, the aspect, or the link's code end.

target.description: What it reaches: the filter's class and the route, the method called and the class that runs it, the method advised, or, for a code end, the link's side (source or target) and its other end.

detail.description: What the line names: the route, the method's name or the annotations an aspect selects by; absent for a code end.

name: data-access
description: How the subject component reaches its unit's databases (#617): Reads and writes (it holds a Spring Data repository, or both reads and writes tables), Reads or Writes.

facts.description: The repository or table-access facts it rests on.
